summary: Man fell ~40 ft from a rock face at Dixon Cove, Horsetooth Reservoir; Larimer County rangers and Poudre Fire stabilized him, moved him down the hillside to a boat; airlifted to a hospital with significant injuries; expected to recover
responding_agency: Larimer County DNR rangers + Poudre Fire Authority, UCHealth medical helicopter
notes: two accounts of the same Saturday afternoon incident: technical rope lowering from Dixon Cove to shoreline (~5:45pm) and ranger photo account of 40-ft fall with boat transport
